entry.title: New: LiuHe#bundle
entry.summary: Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal, and deterministic quality gates — backed by a crash-isolated Rust tree-sitter parse daemon and SQLite index. Exact install spec: @jieai/dsh-malong-bridge. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
